summary: Full-stack verification of folder manager, folder picker, move, persistence, Google Sign-In endpoint & /auth screen redirect. Backend pytest: 24/24 passed including new POST /api/auth/session cases (bogus->401, missing field->422, empty string->422) and seeded creator@promptera.app login + /auth/me regression. Frontend (390x844): onboarding dismissed, scripts-screen renders, manage-folders-button opens folder-manager sheet with the 7 default folders (f_tiktok/f_instagram/f_youtube/f_review/f_ads/f_education/f_personal). Create via folder-new-input + folder-new-add shows toast 'Folder dibuat' and new chip in filter bar. Rename via pencil + folder-rename-save updates row and chip to 'QA Folder Renamed'. Delete f_tiktok shows toast 'Folder dihapus', sample_1 remains under 'Semua' and its 'TikTok' folder tag disappears. Move: script-card-sample_2-menu -> sheet-action-folder-open -> folder-picker opens with folder-option-none; selecting folder-option-f_youtube shows toast 'Skrip dipindahkan' and card tag becomes 'YouTube'; chip-f_youtube filter shows the script. Create-from-picker (folder-picker-new-input + folder-picker-new-add) immediately moves sample_2 to 'FromPicker' and adds a chip. Persistence: after full reload, 'FromPicker' chip and sample_2 tag persist (AsyncStorage). /auth screen renders auth-google 'Lanjutkan dengan Google' above the 'atau' divider and the email form (geom check: google.top=229 < email.top=348); clicking it redirects window.location to https://auth.emergentagent.com/oauth/?redirect=<origin>%2F. Only pre-existing non-blocking warning: react-native-web 'shadow*' prop deprecation (already reported in iteration_1).

issues: With many folders the create/rename controls fall below the modal fold on a 390x844 viewport; test needed JS click to reach folder-new-add and folder-rename-{id}. Users still reach them via scroll inside the sheet, but consider auto-scrolling the FlatList to the active row when rename is tapped on an off-screen entry.

react_native_issues.issue: Pre-existing react-native-web console warning: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated. Use 'boxShadow'. Reproduces on initial render; non-blocking. Already captured in iteration_1.

action_items: (Optional UX) Auto-scroll the folder-manager FlatList to the row being renamed and keep the create input visible when the keyboard is up, so controls remain reachable without manual scroll on 390x844.
(Optional, polish) Migrate StyleSheet shadow* -> boxShadow to silence RN-web deprecation warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: /auth/session validates session_id with Pydantic (min_length=1 -> 422 on empty), exchanges via Emergent, upserts user by email, mints JWT. Non-200 from Emergent -> 401 with explicit detail. No ObjectId leakage (public_user() used).

AuthProvider.tsx: web branch of loginWithGoogle computes window.location.origin + '/' and redirects to AUTH_URL with ?redirect=; hash/search session_id extracted on return and exchanged via /auth/session; exchange guarded by a Set to prevent double-use. Native branch covers both openAuthSessionAsync result and hot deep-link listener.

folders.tsx: FolderManager + FolderPicker share a SheetShell with KeyboardAvoidingView; testIDs on every interactive element (folder-manager, folder-new-input/add, folder-row-<id>, folder-rename-<id>, folder-rename-input-<id>, folder-rename-save-<id>, folder-delete-<id>, folder-picker, folder-option-<id|none>, folder-picker-new-input/add). Rename commits onBlur AND onSubmitEditing/save — good robustness.

library.tsx store: deleteFolder correctly reparents orphaned scripts to folderId=null (so sample_1 stays in 'Semua' with no folder tag after f_tiktok is removed). moveScript persists via storage.setItem; createFolder returns the new Folder so FolderPicker can select it immediately. Uses functional setState -> race-safe.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_promptera_api.py (added 4 tests: google session invalid/missing/empty + seeded creator login regression)

success_rate.frontend: 100% of covered flows (folder create/rename/delete, chip reflect, action-sheet->picker move, picker-create+move, reload persistence, /auth google button layout + redirect to auth.emergentagent.com)

seed_data_creation: Backend tests register fresh test_<uuid>@promptera.app users each run. Creator account creator@promptera.app/secret123 is expected to pre-exist (test skips if 401/404). UI test created local-only folders ('QA Folder' renamed to 'QA Folder Renamed', 'FromPicker') via AsyncStorage; nothing persisted server-side.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Onboarding buttons on this build are 'Lewati'/'Lanjut'/'Mulai' (NOT 'Lanjutkan'). The folder-manager sheet is scrollable but Playwright 'click' may complain 'Element is outside of the viewport' for rows below the modal fold on 390x844 — use JS dispatchEvent('click') to bypass. Google button on /auth redirects to https://auth.emergentagent.com/oauth/?redirect=<origin>/ (note the /oauth/ path auto-appended by the Emergent host); do not follow all the way through. Backend /auth/session uses min_length=1 so empty string yields 422 (not 401).
rca_of_issue: N/A — all requested features working as designed. No regressions in the previously-passing suite.
